Baskin Financial Services Cut Apple (AAPL) Stake by $398,333 as Share Value Declined; Ems Capital LP Boosted Its Ptc (PTC) Holding
May 21, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Baskin Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 1.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baskin Financial Services Inc sold 2,357 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 163,522 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.67 million, down from 165,879 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baskin Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.71% or $1.32 during the last trading session, reaching $187.63. About 16.71 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Edmond M. Safra increased its stake in Ptc Inc (PTC) by 66.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ems Capital Lp bought 240,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 31.32% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Edmond M. Safra held 600,000 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $36.46M, up from 360,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ems Capital Lp who had been investing in Ptc Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.76% or $0.64 during the last trading session, reaching $84.79. About 628,250 shares traded. PTC Inc. (NASDAQ:PTC) has risen 49.73% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 38.18% the S&P500.
Among 56 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 37 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 66% are positive. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Thursday, October 1 with “Buy” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Needham on Friday, March 24. The rating was maintained by UBS with “Buy” on Wednesday, December 16. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird with “Buy” on Wednesday, August 2. Piper Jaffray maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, November 30 report. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, February 13 by Bank of America. Instinet downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Tuesday, December 19 report.
Baskin Financial Services Inc, which manages about $527.27 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vanguard Ftse All (VEU) by 6,011 shares to 93,746 shares, valued at $5.13 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Bank Of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) by 4,829 shares in the quarter, for a total of 263,809 shares, and has risen its stake in Royal Bank Of Canada (NYSE:RY).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.42 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
